metadata.description: Personal skills of ScreamXY for Claude Code and Codex

plugins.name: scrm-show-me
plugins.description: Explain the current topic visually with small diagrams, code-shape sketches, and focused HTML pages.

plugins.name: scrm-grill-me
plugins.description: Stress-test a plan or design with rounds of numbered questions, each with a recommended answer.

plugins.name: scrm-grill-with-docs
plugins.description: Stress-test a plan or design and keep the glossary (CONTEXT.md) and ADRs up to date while you talk.

plugins.name: scrm-wait-what
plugins.description: Explain the last message again in simple words, with the context that was missing.

plugins.name: scrm-handoff
plugins.description: Compact the current conversation into a handoff document for a fresh agent session.

plugins.name: scrm-unslop
plugins.description: Remove AI writing patterns from a text and rewrite it in plain, direct English.

plugins.name: scrm-eli5
plugins.description: Explain a topic very simply, with one HTML page of big pictures and few words.

plugins.name: scrm-babysit-pr
plugins.description: Watch a GitHub or Azure DevOps pull request for a time window: handle review comments, fix valid findings, and follow CI.

plugins.name: scrm-video
plugins.description: Edit holiday and action films with chronological storytelling, music, transitions, photo motion, and private or masked public versions.
